subject: URGENT: Production latency & error spike after V4.1 quant deploy - rollback request
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@apexretail.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Burke <tom.burke@apexretail.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: sudden latency + 500s after your V4.1/quant roll

Hi Soojin,

We pushed your V4.1 quantized variant this morning per the rollout window (09:00 PT). Within ~30 minutes we saw p95 jump from 380ms to 1.8s and a 5xx rate climb to ~1.4%. Several downstream endpoints started timing out (checkout recommendations). We rolled our client retries and it amplified the backlog.

We also observed degraded answer coherence on some product-summarization requests — short answers hallucinating SKU values. This started exactly after the model switch; previous stable for weeks. Can you please rollback to the previous running variant (v4.0-std) and confirm the timeline? Our CX/ops team is getting paged and legal is asking for an incident note.

Attaching a small telemetry sample and a tar of perf dumps we pulled from our side. We need an ETA for rollback or a mitigation plan within the hour.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Platform Engineering
ApexRetail

Attachments: perf_snaps_v4.1.tar.gz (tgz), apex-telemetry-sample.json (json)

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@apexretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-29T09:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: sudden latency + 500s after your V4.1/quant roll

Hi Elena — thanks for the quick heads up and for the attachments. I'm escalating immediately and standing up a rollback plan. Quick notes from our side so you have visibility:

- We've already flagged increased token decode time on the new v4.1 qprofile in our telemetry.
- Early hypothesis: a codepath in the quant kernel concatenation increases KV-cache miss overhead for long prefixes used by your summarization pipeline.
- Rishi and Jonas are running targeted traces now; I will coordinate a canary rollback and keep you updated every 20 minutes.

Planned immediate actions:
1) Initiate canary rollback to v4.0-std for 20% of traffic at 09:40 PT.
2) If metrics revert (p95 and 5xx drop), full rollback by 10:10 PT.
3) Preserve v4.1 logs and perf dumps for the postmortem (we have your attachments).

I will confirm the canary start in the next update. Apologies for the disruption — we treat this with top priority.

— Soojin
SoS, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-29T09:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: sudden latency + 500s after your V4.1/quant roll

On tracing the live fleet:
- v4.1 qprofile shows an 18% increase in decoder kernel latency for sequences > 160 tokens.
- We are also seeing sporadic OOM-related GC spikes on the dedicated pool that lead to transient 5xxs (rare, but correlated).
- KV cache hit rate dropped ~12% for ApexTraffic due to new shard alignment.

I agree with Soojin — push the 20% canary rollback. I've queued a hotfix that disables the new kernel path for long-seq requests while we dig deeper (will require rolling restart of the canary group).

Jonas — can you capture the kernel profile and attach?

-Rishi

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: kernel profiles + exec runbook reference

Attaching quick profile excerpt in-line (full artifacts in shared drive).

> kernel_decode_time_v4.1: 1.11x baseline for seq 161-512
> kv_hit_rate: -12pct on average for apex-traffic shards

Action items:
- Canary rollback at 10:10 PT instead of 09:40 (queue delays) — manual gate opened.
- Marissa: FYI we should loop in CX and Sales leadership; this will likely trigger a credit ask and exec sync given outage scope.

Runbook: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/apex/incident-runbook

— Jonas

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-29T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: kernel profiles + exec runbook reference

Thanks team. I'm pulling legal and GTM. Closing the loop on executive visibility: Vivek, please be aware Apex is flagging potential SLA impact to procurement and the account team expects an exec-to-exec update if this doesn't resolve with rollback.

Sooj, proceed with the canary rollback and ensure we capture the following for postmortem:
- exact traffic split & timing stamps
- client-side retry amplification evidence
- model binary and qprofile hash
- perf artifacts (jonas will place in the shared drive)

Also please draft a short customer-facing status note (2 bullets + ETA) and paste here for review before sending.

-Marissa
VP, Customer Ops
Redwood Inference

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@apexretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-29T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: ACTIONED: Canary rollback started and timeline

Elena — quick status update and confirmed actions: 

- Canary rollback to v4.0-std started at 16:00 PT (20% traffic). Celled metrics show p95 trending back down (now 420ms) and 5xx rate dropped to 0.08%.
- We will complete full rollback to v4.0-std across your pool at 16:25 PT unless we see further regressions.
- We've preserved v4.1 artifacts and put kernel traces and perf dumps in the shared drive (link below).

Customer-facing note (ready to send):
"We detected increased latency and error rate after the v4.1 quantized rollout this morning. We've initiated a rollback to the previously stable variant (v4.0-std). Canary shows p95 returning to baseline; full rollback will complete within ~25 minutes. We will follow up with a postmortem and any remediation credits as needed."

Next steps on our side: full rollback completion, deep postmortem with actionable remediation (qprofile kernel fallback + shard realignment), and a schedule for a non-disruptive re-test. We'll share the postmortem within 48 hours and propose a guarded re-deploy plan.

Link to artifacts: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/apex/incident-runbook
HubSpot: HS-APX-4821

If you'd like a short call for exec sync, Marissa is available at 17:00 PT.

— Soojin
Customer Reliability (Redwood Inference)
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192
